methodology.map_source: Mapbox satellite-streets-v12 static maps, cross-checked in Google Maps satellite view for the five selected-vs-prior conflicts
methodology.map_review_scope: Coast orientation, open-water approach, headland shelter, bay exposure, and whether a proposed direction points into land.
methodology.map_limit: Satellite geometry cannot establish the best swell by itself because bathymetry, refraction, period, tide, and local takeoff configuration are not visible.
methodology.confidence_policy: A geometry-consistent fallback remains low confidence unless an independent spot-specific surf guide or observational source corroborates it.

bcn-baja-malibu.map_finding: The straight west-facing coast is open to SSW through NW energy; north and east directions are landward or nearly alongshore.
bcn-baja-malibu.note: The selected window covers Surfline's SSW, SW, WNW, and NW regimes and Surf-Forecast's SW preference without treating due north as ideal.

bcn-marisol-north-point.map_finding: The point sits on a west-facing coast; the imported N-to-E range points alongshore and into land.
bcn-marisol-north-point.note: Surf-Forecast and International Surf Properties independently identify WNW. The conflicting SurfTrips page incorrectly places the spot on Lake Michigan and is excluded for swell-window evidence.

bcn-la-mision.map_finding: The open beach and river-mouth coast face west with usable southwest-to-northwest exposure.
bcn-la-mision.note: Published spot guidance identifies W and NW; coastal research reports predominantly W waves in winter and SW in summer.

bcs-punta-santo-domingo.map_finding: The break is on a curving south-to-southwest-facing bay and point; northwest is substantially shadowed by land configuration.
bcs-punta-santo-domingo.note: Surf-Forecast identifies south as best and DeepSwell describes a south-facing beach and reef. The broader SW-to-NW SurfTrips range is not retained.

bcs-monuments.map_finding: The rocky headland and bay face south-southwest through west; the selected range approaches the exposed water rather than the landward northeast quadrant.
bcs-monuments.note: Surfline and SurfTrips agree on SSW, SW, and W energy, including deepwater-canyon amplification of long-period W and SW swell.

bcn-salsipuedes.map_finding: The wrapping point and bay are exposed to west and northwest; southwest is blocked and loses size around the point.
bcn-salsipuedes.note: Surfline explicitly says W and NW, with more west being better, and says SW does not enter with meaningful size.

bcs-playa-san-pedro.map_finding: The open Pacific beach faces southwest; the source fallback's NW-to-NNW range points into the landward side of the shoreline.
bcs-playa-san-pedro.note: Surf-Forecast's guide-level NW label conflicts with its own directed-swell forecasts and the mapped coast. Repeated directed forecasts identify SSW and SW energy, so the corrected range remains medium rather than high confidence.
